verdict.rationale: Clara's own API lets you retrieve transactions, cards, users and invoices programmatically, documented by an OpenAPI 3.1 schema. Its reconciliation guide describes pulling all transactions for a billing period and exporting them to an accounting system. That gives meaningful API-based data portability, but there is no documented complete data export or account offboarding. missing for 10: a documented bulk or complete export of all account data, named open file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps) outside per-endpoint API calls, account closure or data deletion terms, and independent corroboration that a full exit works.
